test_read_csv_basic: test reading a CSV file with pl.read_csv and verify parsed DataFrame columns and dtypes
test_read_csv_compressed: test reading gzip, zlib, and zstd compressed CSV files with pl.read_csv and pl.scan_csv
test_read_csv_datetime_parsing: test try_parse_dates option for automatic datetime parsing in pl.read_csv
test_read_csv_schema_overrides: test schema_overrides parameter with dict or list to override column dtypes in pl.read_csv
test_read_csv_null_values: test null_values parameter with string, list, or dict to specify custom null representations
test_read_csv_column_selection: test columns parameter to select specific columns by name or index in pl.read_csv
test_read_csv_batched: test pl.read_csv_batched for low-memory streaming CSV reads with next_batches method
test_write_csv_roundtrip: test writing a DataFrame to CSV with pl.DataFrame.write_csv and reading it back
test_write_csv_float_precision: test float_precision and float_scientific parameters in write_csv for numeric formatting
test_write_csv_decimal_comma: test decimal_comma parameter for European-style comma decimal separators in write_csv
test_write_csv_quote_styles: test quote_style parameter with always, necessary, non_numeric, and never options
test_scan_csv_lazy: test pl.scan_csv for lazy evaluation and streaming of large CSV files
test_csv_ragged_lines: test truncate_ragged_lines parameter to handle rows with mismatched field counts
test_csv_skip_rows_and_lines: test skip_rows, skip_rows_after_header, and skip_lines parameters for header offset
test_csv_comment_prefix: test comment_prefix parameter to skip comment lines during CSV parsing
test_csv_encoding: test encoding parameter with big5 and windows-1251-lossy for non-UTF-8 CSV files
test_csv_categorical: test Categorical dtype handling in CSV read and write with schema_overrides
test_csv_bom_handling: test UTF-8 BOM detection and stripping in read_csv and scan_csv
test_csv_newline_handling: test eol_char parameter for custom line endings and embedded newlines in fields
